title_es: LED con Arduino en la protoboard
description: Candidate demo task: wire a blinking LED on a breadboard to an Arduino whose blink sketch (pin 13) is already loaded. LED, resistor to the ground rail, signal wire from pin 13, ground wire, and the USB cable last; the LED blinking is the visible result.

steps.instruction_es: Pon el LED en la protoboard, cada pata en una columna distinta.
steps.completion_cue: LED standing in the breadboard, legs in two different columns

steps.instruction_es: Pon la resistencia desde la pata corta del LED hasta el riel azul.
steps.completion_cue: resistor from the LED's short-leg column to the blue rail

steps.instruction_es: Conecta un cable rojo del pin 13 a la columna de la pata larga del LED.
steps.completion_cue: red wire from pin 13 to the LED's long-leg column

steps.instruction_es: Conecta un cable negro de GND en la placa al riel azul.
steps.completion_cue: black wire from a GND pin to the blue rail

steps.instruction_es: Listo el circuito: ahora conecta el cable USB a la placa.
steps.completion_cue: USB cable plugged into the board and the LED blinking

mistakes.description: Inserts the LED with its legs swapped.
mistakes.visual_cue: LED's short leg (flat side) in the signal column and its long leg toward the resistor
mistakes.correction_es: Ojo, el LED está al revés: la pata larga va hacia el cable del pin 13.

mistakes.description: Puts both resistor legs in the same column, so it doesn't reach the ground rail.
mistakes.visual_cue: both resistor legs in one breadboard column, nothing reaching the blue rail
mistakes.correction_es: La resistencia no está llegando al riel azul: una pata va junto al LED y la otra en el riel.

mistakes.description: Plugs the signal wire into a pin other than 13.
mistakes.visual_cue: red wire's board end in pin 12 or another pin, not 13
mistakes.correction_es: Ojo, ese cable no está en el pin 13: muévelo al 13, al lado de GND.

mistakes.description: Powers the board before the circuit is finished.
mistakes.visual_cue: USB cable plugged in while the LED, resistor or wires are still missing
mistakes.correction_es: Ojo, desconecta el USB: la placa se conecta al final, con el circuito listo.
